text:
nina: FYI incoming vendor pen test next Wed. We need a clear plan for RBAC changes + KMS scoping + audit snapshots. Draft plan below, please quick review.

omar: high-level looks good. two asks: enforce principal/session tagging and require presigned uploads only.

sophia: Ops notes: we'll provision ephemeral role `vendor-pt-assessor` only during window. Scripted create/attach then detach/delete. Test in staging first.

nina: minimal policy snippet (attach to role):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-temp-key-2026",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/pt_ticket": "PT-303"}
      }
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-snapshots/*",
      "Condition": {
        "Bool": {"aws:RequestTag/presigned": "true"}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

devsec-bot: Reminder: require NDA before handing presigned URLs. Presign example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-snapshots/vendor/scan.tgz --expires-in 3600`

omar: For auditability add `aws:PrincipalTag/session_type=assessor` and require `aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true` on sensitive actions.

tara: Compliance: enable S3 ObjectLock governance on the audit bucket and 90d retention. Ensure redaction pipeline strips PII before files go to the vendor. Who will own redaction?

sophia: Platform can run a redaction job in staging and produce sanitized artifacts. We'll add a checksum/signature to prove redaction performed.

compliance-bot: Note: if any customer data is discovered in scope, stop and contact legal immediately; DPA addendum required.

nina: Monitoring: plan to snapshot CloudTrail and application logs every 30m during the window and copy to `redwood-pt-snapshots`. Splunk query to capture KMS ops: `index=cloudtrail eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt | stats count by user, awsRegion` run every 15m.

omar: Revert playbook (ops):
```
# teardown-vendor-pt.sh
aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name vendor-pt-assessor --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/pt-assessor-pt303
aws iam delete-role --role-name vendor-pt-assessor || true
# revoke sessions and rotate any grants
```

sophia: I'll run staging dry-run tomorrow 14:00 PT and post results.

sre-oncall: I'll take the prod window; propose Tue Apr 13 09:00-10:30 PT. Blocking calendar now.

tara: I'll confirm NDA and ownership of redaction by EOD.

nina: Thanks all 1: once staging dry-run passes we'll finalize window and handoff checklist.
